Afternoon: Enjoy a traditional Turkish meal at a nearby restaurant, savoring dishes such as kebabs, meze, and baklava. In the evening, you can choose to visit Topkapi Palace if you have time or simply enjoy a leisurely stroll along the historic streets of the city.

Afternoon: Return to the city center and visit the Galata Tower, providing panoramic views of Istanbul. Descend the tower and explore the Galata district, known for its vibrant atmosphere and street food vendors.
Evening: Dine at a local restaurant serving traditional Turkish cuisine, such as lamb kebabs, stuffed grape leaves, and pide (Turkish pizza).

Day 4: 
Morning: Visit the Basilica Cistern, an underground water reservoir dating back to the Byzantine era. Marvel at its impressive size and intricate carvings.
Afternoon: Spend some time shopping at the Grand Bazaar, but this time focus on purchasing souvenirs and gifts for friends and family. If you still have time, consider visiting the nearby Spice Bazaar for more unique items.

- Start the day with a hike to Bear Lake (2 miles round-trip, 600 feet elevation gain). Enjoy scenic views of the surrounding mountains and wildlife viewing opportunities.

- Return to your accommodation in the evening and enjoy a campfire experience with s'mores and marshmallows.

- Return to your accommodation and spend the evening preparing for tomorrow's whitewater rafting excursion.
